arStrings.szText: {c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} increases your damage by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|1%x|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds whenever you gain {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also Heals you and your allies for {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_13})]){/c} per second.

Healing yourself and allies grants {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} every {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} second.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also grants {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} Thorns and increases you and your allies' Thorns by {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|%+|]{/c}.

{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} active instead releases a nova dealing {c_number}[SF_20*100|%x|]{/c} of your Thorns damage.
{c_important}Defiance Aura's{/c} passive also grants you and your allies {c_number}[SF_8*100]%{/c} Maximum Life.
{c_important}Defiance Aura{/c} grants you and your allies {c_number}[{SF_30} * 100|%|]{/c} Healing received.
{c_important}Defiance Aura{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_32 * 100 |%|]{/c} more bonus from potency.

Whenever you or an ally are Injured, they become {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds and gain {c_number}{SF_38}{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}.  This can only occur once every {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} seconds
